title: Fuel Charging and Controls — 5.0L 32V Ti-VCT
introduction:
Fuel metering is the engine’s portion control: supplying fuel is one job, and understanding how that job is controlled takes a closer look. I start by separating how the system works from what its individual components do.

For this engine, both explanations are in the Powertrain Control/Emissions Diagnosis (PC/ED) manual. This page provides the directions to that reference; it contains no component inventory, diagnostic test or repair procedure.

edits.text: For the fuel-charging and controls system-operation explanation, open the Powertrain Control/Emissions Diagnosis (PC/ED) manual at Section 1, Description and Operation.
edits.why: Start with system operation to understand the overall job before focusing on individual parts.

edits.text: For descriptions of the fuel-charging and controls components, open the Powertrain Control/Emissions Diagnosis (PC/ED) manual at Section 1, Description and Operation.
